mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.8% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 3.8%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.4 million units signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenues and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1.4 million, or the average return in high-HOUST periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 104.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and reduces equity valuations over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 104.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 298.0 and FEDFUNDS above 3.0% signals persistent inflation and a restrictive monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 298.0 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in RSAFS above 680,000 million and HOUST above 1.4 million signals strong consumer spending and housing demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings growth expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where both RSAFS > 680000 and HOUST > 1400, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PAYEMS above 153,000 thousand combined with a decline in UNRATE below 3.7% signals a rapidly tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 153000 and UNRATE < 3.7%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDPC1 below 20,000 billion in the prior quarter signals weakening aggregate demand and economic contraction, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 falls below 20,000, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
